author: StefaniaHergane
title: Debian Packages job fails - apt-get cannot resolve archive.ubuntu.com mirrors (DNS resolution failure)
signature: temporary failure resolving ubuntu archive mirror hosts during apt get update package has no installation candidate|Network

failed_jobs.name: Debian Packages / Debian Packages
failed_jobs.symptom: apt-get update fails with 'Temporary failure resolving' for all Ubuntu/Azure mirrors, causing gnupg/wget/ca-certificates/lsb-release to have no installation candidate

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status check fails because the Debian Packages job failed

key_errors:
Err:1 http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu jammy InRelease
  Temporary failure resolving 'archive.ubuntu.com'

Err:3 http://azure.archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu jammy InRelease
  Temporary failure resolving 'azure.archive.ubuntu.com'

E: Package 'gnupg' has no installation candidate
E: Unable to locate package wget
E: Package 'ca-certificates' has no installation candidate
E: Unable to locate package lsb-release
root_cause: The runner lost DNS resolution for all configured Ubuntu/Azure apt mirrors (archive.ubuntu.com, security.ubuntu.com, azure.archive.ubuntu.com) during the 'Install debian packages & check conflicts' step. apt-get update retried for ~1 minute (per the configured Acquire::Retries) and ultimately failed with 'Temporary failure resolving', leaving the local package index empty/stale, so the subsequent apt-get install for gnupg, wget, ca-certificates, and lsb-release reported 'no installation candidate'/'Unable to locate package'. This is a transient runner/network infrastructure issue unrelated to the PR's NPU compiler-adapter code changes.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible outside CI; depends on transient DNS resolution failure for Ubuntu apt mirrors from the GitHub Actions runner's network.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'Debian Packages' job; this is a transient DNS/network failure unrelated to the PR's source changes
If recurrence continues, consider adding retries with longer backoff around apt-get update/install in job_debian_packages.yml, or pin/cache a known-good apt mirror
Monitor whether the runner pool (aks-linux-4-cores-16gb) has a broader networking/DNS issue given the recurring pattern across many merge-queue runs
prevention_strategies: Add resilience to the Debian Packages install step: increase Acquire::Retries, add a short sleep+retry wrapper around 'apt-get update', and/or fall back to an alternate mirror if DNS resolution fails repeatedly. Track mirror outage frequency to decide if self-hosted/cached mirrors are warranted.
historical_context: This exact signature (DNS resolution failure for Ubuntu/Azure apt mirrors during the Debian Packages job) has now been seen 7 times in repo-memory, 6 of them within the last ~3 hours (2026-11-11T14:34 - 17:15 UTC), affecting PR #39262, #39532, and #39693. Several related but distinct Network/Infrastructure signatures for the same job (connection timeout/refused, OOM, 404s) are also tracked separately.
